## Problem
Describe the missing metadata, suspicious value, coverage gap, unit mismatch, or quality-flag concern.

## Geographic and temporal coverage
- Date range:
- Region or bounding box:

## Evidence
Include a provider documentation link, checksum or metadata excerpt where possible. Never publish access tokens.

## Impact
- [ ] Blocks processing
- [ ] Changes valid-pixel coverage
- [ ] May affect lag estimates
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Unknown

## Reproduction
Describe the smallest steps needed to verify the problem. Distinguish a suspected issue from one already confirmed against source files.
